title: dReps Onboarding: Empowering Cardano Ghana Community

ms.promise:
1. Organize a physical event in the Northern Region & Ashanti Region of Ghana, focusing on:
 - Introduction to dReps and Voting
 - Individual voting and delegating to dRep
 - How to delegate vote to a dRep and how to become a dRep
 - Benefits of delegating vote to a dRep
2. Distribute dRep educational materials to 100 participants.
3. Ensure participants comprehend dReps and the importance of delegating their vote or becoming a dRep.
4. Provide 110 branded Cardano T-shirts to participants and Team.
5. Facilitate learning sessions on Cardano Blockchain and Project Catalyst.
ms.criteria:
1. Create and display an event poster and banner.
2. Develop a comprehensive dRep educational brochure.
3. Prepare a registration form for participants.
4. Acquire and distribute branded Cardano T-shirts.
5. Share event pictures and short videos on Cardano Ghana's Facebook and other relevant platforms.
ms.report:
Milestone 1: dRep Onboarding in the Northern Region, Tamale & Ashanti Region, Kumasi
I’m excited to report on the success completion of M1 of onboarding dReps from Tamale and Kumasi. Our events engaged over 100+ participants on the concept of dreps, Voting and its delegation as well as the benefits associated. More light were thrown on projects catalyst in both events. Branded Cardano T-Shirts and dReps educational brochure were procured for the training. Lunch and water were provided for everyone to keep participants refreshed and energetic. We also share relevant link for more information on dreps and Cardano governance at the events. 
Acceptance criteria
・Create and display an event poster and banner.
・Develop a comprehensive dRep educational brochure.
・Prepare a registration form for participants.
・Acquire and distribute branded Cardano T-shirts.
・Share event pictures and short videos on Cardano Ghana's Facebook and other relevant platforms.

ms.report:
Milestone 2: dReps Onboarding in the Greater Accra Region, Accra
Hi there, time to report on the success completion of milestone 2 of our project. On May 11, 2024 we were in the capital city of Ghana thus Accra at the University of Ghana’s SRC Union Building to engage the Cardano community in the region on the DRep program, why participate in the program and how to participate. We also make time to have interactive session on project catalyst particular on the roles in project catalyst, the need to participate in the community review, how active participation is rewarding. The dReps presentation was preceded by the roadmap of Cardano to give participate clue and fair understanding of what delegated representative is. The event was facilitated by three people thus Mr. Seidu Ziblim, the project lead, Madam Afia Owusu, WADA Accra hub lead and Madam Awura, Member of Cardano Community. The event saw 53 participants registered but 48 people show up on the event day. We share branded Cardano T-Shirts and dReps educational brochure to all participants. Lunch and Snacks were provided for everyone to keep participants refreshed and energetic. We also share relevant links for more information on dReps and Cardano governance at the events. The completion of this M2 gives us 150 beneficiaries of the project. It further gives the project 75% to conclude.

ms.report:
Final Milestone: dRep Onboarding in the Upper West Region, Wa
Hello Milestone Reviewers and Catalyst Team, final milestone achieved for our dReps onboarding events project. Climaxing the events in Wa, we had 55 people showing up to learn about Cardano and the concept of dReps. Discussions went on well as the event was open by the esteemed Cardano Ambassador, Mohammed Mustapha Yakubu who joined as virtual to speak on the roadmap of Cardano, project catalyst and upcoming events in Cardano ecosystem. Seidu Ziblim, the project lead continue the program on the concept dReps presentation, demonstrate on how to become a DRep, how to navigate on SanchoNet site. He ceased the opportunity to introduce participants to IntersectMBO and guide them to join as Associate funding members of the organization. He encouraged them to join the available working groups there to improve their skills. We share branded Cardano T-Shirts and dReps educational brochure to all participants. Lunch and Snacks were provided for everyone to keep participants refreshed and energetic. We also share relevant links for more information on dReps and Cardano governance at the events. The completion of this milestone gives us 200 beneficiaries of the project which represents 100% of the project.
